caseNameFull: SAMSON MARKET CO., INC. v. KIRBY, DIRECTOR, DEPARTMENT OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Jacques Leslie and Lawrence Teplin for appellant., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, and Warren H. Deering and Henry G. Ullerich, Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
